description: Heat.gov Map Gallery is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by NOAA GeoPlatform. The individual maps included in this application include: Current Heat Forecast Current Temperatures CPC Temperature Outlooks Extreme Heat Days in 2050 Days Above 90 deg F in 2050 Details of each map can be found in their item description. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of NOAA GeoPlatform. Its keywords are Heat, temperature, NOAA, CPC, climate, NWS, National Weather Service, USGCRP. The hub shows 2025-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
